body:
The soft, layered entrances are back in 849b2da and running in the existing HTTPS app: views, dialogs, menus, toolbars, Calendar and card details appear in layers again with their original timing and curves, at the owner's direction. The rest of the interface refinement is unchanged.

Removing them had been a wrong reading of the minimalism brief. Changes to this motion need the owner's agreement first. Evidence: progress/2026-10-06-layered-motion-restored.md.
